summary: New box Preterit Intransitive: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (96/216)

data.turoyo: Mḥelela i kamanayḏé, napəl xalxolo me raġla. Mədle u xalxolawo, u səḥər diḏa tle.
data.translation: Er spielte auf seiner Fiedel, da fiel eine Fußspange von ihrem Fuß herab. Er nahm die Fußspange, da wurde der Zauber der Störehin aufgehoben.

rationale: New Preterit Intransitive box in this p-entry; anklet falls from the leg.

summary: New box Preterit Intransitive: example for sense 2 in Preterit Intransitive (96/254)

data.turoyo: Walḥaṣəl məllela, omər: "Ašər, lebi napəl ebax." Hiye ste əmmo: "Lebi napəl ebux."
data.translation: Um es kurz zu machen: Er sprach zu ihr: Ich liebe dich! - und auch sie sprach: Ich liebe dich! -

rationale: New sense2; two reciprocal heart-subject love assertions in Preterit Intransitive.

summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (96/290)

data.turoyo: Hano, ḥa yawmo, Qarabuluṭ, ḥəngi d kətyo ḥurma ṣpahiye, šafərto, gəzza maṣiġo qarʕa l fema di bərke, efendim gməḥyo w msarqo b qarʕa, gnopəl manṯo me d qarʕa bi bərke w məḥyo i šalqe dam maye aʕle w gməblole l walaye.
data.translation: Eines Tages ging Schwarzwolke, die eine sehr schöne Frau war, an das Ufer eines Teiches, um sich den Kopf zu waschen. Beim Kämmen fiel ein Haar aus ihrem Schopfe in den Teich. Die Welle faßte es und trug es zu einer Stadt.

rationale: New Infectum box; hair falls from head into pool, retaining p.

data.translation: Vielleicht findet sie dann Ruhe, daß sie stehen und sitzen kann.

rationale: Single clear relief construction3 in Infectum; cut to the complete hoped-for result.

summary: New sense 3: über jemanden kommen, jemanden erfassen (Ruhe; mit b- für die Person);

summary: Permitted nfl lookup confirms common MEA npl etymology, nafəl/nofəl, loveI11, and mental/emotional-stateI10. This supports comparison but does not authorize collapsing the p-entry or importing its full sense inventory.
New Preterit Intransitive and Infectum are missing from this entry, even though the f-entry already has them. The claim is local to npl, not a new discovery for the whole variant family.
Heart acts as experiencer-bearing subject with beloved coded b-; relief likewise acts as state subject with affected person b-. Body-part and state constructions differ from literal objects falling.
96/287 Infectum-wa expresses an unreal condition. Actual p/f variation inside that verse is retained without normalization or a silent root merger.
Should npl be consolidated under nfl with p-form cross-reference, or retained as a dialect entry? No senses or examples are moved between roots in this proposal.
Confirm gender/agreement in97/49 nopəl raḥa and96/290 gnopəl manṯo before interpreting apparent masculine forms with feminine nouns.
Confirm whether97/49 relief is the same broad state-onset construction as nflI10 or merits a narrower gloss; the npl proposal is restricted to attested Ruhe.
